newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FLAT ON OPEN AFTER MIDDAY RISE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV ENDS FLAT ON OPEN AFTER MIDDAY RISE.

text.p: The lev closed at 1,650-1,700 per dollar, unchanged from opening but down from midday highs of 1,600-1,620 due to a rise in dollar demand from a final client, dealers said.
"A fuel importer started bidding for cheap dollars at noon, pressuring the lev back to its morning levels," a dealer said.
The lev dipped to 1,750-1,780 in early afternoon due to the client's foreign currency buying but quickly recovered to 1,650-1,700 after the importer withdrew from the market.
Traders said the lev was expected to ease on Thursday due to the longer value date of spot deals and expectations the fuel importer would resume bidding for dollars.
